items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section XVI, List of Answers on Terminology 153:1
items.html: The Malchut of Bina, who is not included in the Mochin of ZA and always remains in the light of smallness, surrounds ZON from outside them and protects them in the secret of a partition, so that the externals cannot grip in ZON. And this is the secret of the garments and shoes of ZON, for the guard beneath their feet, in the secret of the Parsa beneath Atzilut, is the secret of a shoe. And that which surrounds them in their entire stature is the secret of the garments. (Item 33).
